entities.summary: Nikolay Nikolayevich Strakhov, also transliterated as Nikolai Strahov was a Russian philosopher, publicist, journalist and literary critic. He shared the ideals of Pochvennichestvo and was a longtime friend and correspondent of Leo Tolstoy.
